purpose: Raw material for the holding's weapon rack (Lore 14.15: a rack of twisted logs lashed up by the post): every candidate of one create_image_pro call, a numbered sheet, the pick and a contact sheet. ART cleans the pick, places it in its 64x72 cell (origin (32, 64)), adds its peg points and writes art/sheets/prop-weapon-rack.json. No recipe, no art:build, no code, nothing retouched, recoloured, cut, scaled, padded or trimmed here.
style_sentence: Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a high three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark violet outline, flat shading in two or three steps per material, no dithering on the object, no anti-aliasing, no soft glow, transparent background, no text, letters or symbols.

arguments.description: An empty weapon rack made of twisted, gnarled bronze-brown logs lashed together with rope: two short upright posts, a crossbar near the top with three short wooden pegs sticking out toward the viewer, and a lower crossbar. It stands on the ground, seen from the front and above, about as tall as a person and twice as wide as it is deep. No weapons on it. Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a high three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark violet outline, flat shading in two or three steps per material, no dithering on the object, no anti-aliasing, no soft glow, transparent background, no text, letters or symbols.

the same world and palette: a prop that already stands on this holding, its rope lashing
scale only: this is the player, 45 px tall; the rack stands beside it

step1_weapon_rack.retake_check: Candidates 0, 2, 4 and 5 are empty upright racks with visible pegs (10 is one too, in the wrong ramp), so the retake rule (no candidate an empty upright rack) does not apply. No retake.

pick.why: #4 (52x53) is the shortest of the four clear racks (#0 52x61, #2 52x59, #5 54x58) and so the closest to 56-60 x 40-44: 4 px narrower and 9 px taller than the target. It reads at once as the brief: two posts of gnarled bronze wood, a top crossbar with three pegs, a lower crossbar, rope at every joint with two loose rope ends hanging from the top corners, lit from the top left, empty. No candidate is wider than tall: every one is 41-54 wide and 53-61 tall, so none meets the width or the height; the pegs on every rack point up from the crossbar rather than toward the viewer. Size is not a retake reason. Not placed, padded or trimmed: a straight copy of candidates/4.png.

colour_notes.outline: The pick outlines in dream-night #1C2147 (482 px), the player-only outline, as every holding pick did: the description asked for a 1 px dark violet outline and the palette snapped it there. Props take hollow-deep #2A2540 (84 px here, the deepest wood shade and the gaps). Not recoloured; ART maps the outline by role.
colour_notes.skin_ramp: The wood's shade is unwritten-tar #5E5448 (289 px), the skin-ramp colour, as the twisted tree's raw pick was; ART maps it to the bronze/leather ramp (wheel-brass-dark or hollow-deep).
colour_notes.wood: watcher-bronze #A8743A 265 px (base), wheel-brass #C79A3E 199 (lit), wheel-brass-dark #8A6420 44 (shade): the brief's wood ramp, though most of the shading went to unwritten-tar instead of wheel-brass-dark.
colour_notes.rope: sleeper-ochre #9C5B4A 128 px, the brief's rope colour; the rope has no lit step (sleeper-flesh #C98F78 does not appear anywhere in the call).
colour_notes.husk_core_and_green: No candidate uses husk-core #FFF4C7 or wheel-patina #2F7F7A; no green anywhere.
colour_notes.reserved: No pixel in any file is #FFFFFF, #FFE7A3, #E0457B or #8E2550: every candidate is on the 28-colour palette with no semi-transparent pixel.

contact: contact.png: the pick at 4x on floor_0 tiled (12 x 5 tiles), its lowest pixel on the last row of its 2 x 1 footprint (tiles (5, 3) and (6, 3), each outlined in hollow-deep as a 1 px tile grid) and centred on it, the Writ post (frame-0) on tile (3, 3) to its west and the player anchor on tile (8, 3) to its east, each with its cell origin (32, 54) on its tile's bottom centre; below it the candidates sheet at 2x.
